description.value: You're constantly recording, aiming for that perfect camera angle or sound bite. You can perform the Livestream exploration activity at the same time as other exploration activities. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Earn Income] that use your footage, such as Performance or Infosphere Lore, as long as you have at least 8 hours of footage recorded since the last time you attempted to Earn Income. If you're a master in Performance, this bonus increases to +2; if you're legendary in Performance, this bonus increases to +3.
